answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 7554 Country: India Title: My questions are as following i)That,you might kindly explain that what is that we have to read after FARZ NIMAZ and what is the way? 2)That,whatever has to be read after FARZ NIMAZ,in what tone has it to be read(in low tone or high or middle tone or how)? 3)That,upto what time is the link between Imam Sahib and muqtadis in a farz nimaz? 4)That,is the Imam Sahib responsible for whatever has to be read after the farz nimaz? I hope that you will reply soon as it is an urgency. Question: Aslaam U Alaikum Wa Rehmatullahi Wa Barakatahu Respected Ulemas My questions are as following i)That,you might kindly explain that what is that we have to read after FARZ NIMAZ and what is the way? 2)That,whatever has to be read after FARZ NIMAZ,in what tone has it to be read(in low tone or high or middle tone or how)? 3)That,upto what time is the link between Imam Sahib and muqtadis in a farz nimaz? 4)That,is the Imam Sahib responsible for whatever has to be read after the farz nimaz? I hope that you will reply soon as it is an urgency. KHUDA HAFIZ Answer ID: 7554 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 951/951=M/1429) One should first offer the sunnah and nawafil after obligatory salah, then he should recite other zikrs like Ayatul Kursi and Tasbihat etc. And, after the obligatory prayers which are not followed by sunnah and nawafil prayers, one can recite the other zikrs and duas. There is no prescribed way for the same. (2) One should recite it softly. If alone, one can recite a bit louder. (3) The link continues to salam . (4) No. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
